consensus_findings.description: Optional: Trusted Host dispatch contract text is placed after the untrusted {{batch}}/{{ready_set}} regions (rubric-prompt.md:38-43). sanitize_string only redacts secrets and does not neutralize delimiter clones, so an excerpt containing END UNTRUSTED CANDIDATE MANIFEST can close the fence early and append instructions into the trailing trusted section. Reordering trusted model instructions above all untrusted payloads hardens the prompt-injection boundary without changing D2/D8 semantics.
